_meta.description: Published empirical numbers from section 5 of docs/paper-draft.md. `reproduce.py` re-runs each study and reports the delta against these. Count metrics are exact-reproducible (any delta is a real regression); timing ratios vary by machine and are checked within a tolerance band.
_meta.note: Run `python -m evaluation.reproduce --update-baseline` at a fresh release tag to re-anchor these to the version you submit against.

sbom_diff._paper: 5.3 SBOM diff: 121 functions (72 pure, 49 with caps), 61 attribution facts, 6 capability axes

cve._paper: 5.1 quantitative: N=150, 74.0% structural reject, 23.3% attenuation, 97.3% Capa-relevant

micro_overhead._paper: 5.2 micro: fib 3.52x (overflow-checked integer arithmetic worst case), scope_analyser 1.40x, ua_parse 1.91x (Capa vs hand-Python)
micro_overhead._note: fib is high because every Int op routes through an overflow-checked helper (_capa_iadd/_capa_isub); this is the cost of the loud-overflow guarantee, not a transpiler inefficiency. Machine-dependent; re-anchor with --update-baseline on the submission machine.
